# distributed-cache-cluster

Replicated in-memory cache cluster with consistent hashing, SWIM-style gossip membership, quorum reads and writes and rebalancing, tested under a seeded fault-injecting network simulator. Maven artifact `io.github.trysac:distributed-cache-cluster`, Java package `io.github.trysac.distributed_cache_cluster`, MIT licensed, Java >= 21, standard library only.
